notes.title: A guide for the demo version is now available.
notes.notes:
Hello to all!


I've just made an update to the demo version of Daedalic Complex so that the game folder will also include a single pdf file, which is a guide document to help you play the demo without any major difficulties.

Practically, the guide also works the same for a tutorial stage of the full game, too. However, I'm still not sure if it's going to be beneficial even for the people who already bought and are up to play the full copy of Daedalic Complex; thus, I won't upload the guide file(which only helps you get through the tutorial stage) to the full-version program until the considerable amounts of requests are made for sure. 

The guide is not supposed to be a 'mandatory' material you have to go through in order to play the demo. It just helps you play the game without serious difficulties or problems. So, should there be any occasion where you can't clear the demo at all, you'll just have to refer to the guide file in the program folder.


Hope it's gonna be a great help for you to enjoy the demo!


Best regards,
ghilplip934.

notes.title: Full version finally released and available!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!


The full-version game of Daedalic Complex has been finally released and became available for everyone. There will be a 20% discount on the full-price of the game for a week starting from today, 8th of November, so don't miss the chance!

I really wish the full game here will provide a challenging, and yet fun and exciting experience to all of you playing Daedalic Complex. Should there be any bug or error, I ask you to let me know about them fast so that I could make adjustments or bug-fixes ASAP for your gaming experiences.


Thank you all for reading this announcement!

Best regards,
ghilplip934.

notes.title: A minor update to the demo version program.
notes.notes:
Hello to all!


I've just made some few, minor updates for the demo version game of Daedalic Complex, all of which were already applied to the not-released-yet full version as well.

Contents of the updates are followings:

1. Faster movement speed for characters in the game
2. Changes of sprite designs of some characters


These updates are not huge enough to change the whole demo version upside down, so don't worry whether your gaming experience so far will go ruined; I made these slight changes only to keep up with the improved functions and features of upcoming full-version of the game. :)

Hope you keep enjoying the demo-version of Daedalic Complex!


With my best regards,
ghilplip934

notes.title: Earlier release date for the full version. (15th to 8th of november)
notes.notes:
Hello, folks!

A planned, release date for the full version of Daedalic Complex became earlier than the original date, making it available from 8th of november this year. In other words, on 8th(other than 15th) you can play the whole game straight away, enjoying all the things Daedalic Complex has to offer for you!

I'm hoping you'll enjoy the full game just as you did with the demo version. :)


Best regards,
ghilplip934.

notes.title: A playable demo version is now avaliable!
notes.notes:
Hello to all!


[b]A free demo version of the game is now available[/b] for everyone to be played right away. 

This demonstration version contains a single stage, which is also included in the main game to serve as a tutorial, with its estimated playing time to be around 30 to 60 minutes. It does not have all the equipments, items, status ailments and et cetera just like the main game, but still, the demo version can alone do its job of letting you know the basic concepts and ideas of Daedalic Complex that is coming on 15th of november this year.


Hope you enjoy playing this demo version and have fun. See you around!

Best regards,
ghilplip934.
